message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"fuzz_verify.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":107,"var":"Data/Size","code":"write (fd, Data, Size)","note":"The attacker-controlled fuzz input is written verbatim into the temporary .gpg file that GnuPG later parses."},
  {"step":2,"file":"fuzz_verify.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":115,"var":"filename","code":"verify_signatures(ctrlGlobal, 1, &filename)","note":"Verification is invoked on the file containing the crafted bytes, causing the parser to consume the attacker input."},
  {"step":3,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"proc_signature_packets","line":1398,"var":"a","code":"rc = do_proc_packets (c, a)","note":"Signature verification drives the common packet-processing loop over the input stream."},
  {"step":4,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"do_proc_packets","line":1515,"var":"pkt","code":"while ((rc=parse_packet (&parsectx, pkt)) != -1)","note":"Packets are repeatedly decoded from the attacker-controlled byte stream."},
  {"step":5,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"do_proc_packets","line":1575,"var":"pkt->pkttype","code":"case PKT_PLAINTEXT: proc_plaintext (c, pkt); break;","note":"A literal-data packet is dispatched to proc_plaintext, which frees the current packet after processing."},
  {"step":6,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"proc_plaintext","line":827,"var":"pt","code":"PKT_plaintext *pt = pkt->pkt.plaintext;","note":"The plaintext packet contents are read and used to update verification state before the packet object is released."},
  {"step":7,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"proc_plaintext","line":923,"var":"pkt","code":"free_packet (pkt, NULL);","note":"The plaintext packet is freed here, but the surrounding packet list still retains references used later during signature handling."},
  {"step":8,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"do_check_sig","line":1245,"var":"node->pkt","code":"if (c->list->pkt->pkttype == PKT_PUBLIC_KEY || c->list->pkt->pkttype == PKT_PUBLIC_SUBKEY)","note":"Signature verification later walks the retained packet list and dereferences packet nodes that may already have been freed and replaced."},
  {"step":9,"file":"g10/mainproc.c","function":"do_check_sig","line":1269,"var":"sig->digest","code":"memcpy (sig->digest, buffer, sig->digest_len);","note":"The stale packet metadata is used in a memory copy, producing the ASAN heap-use-after-free read seen in the crash state."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print(p)
PY
cat > /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/poc.bin <<'EOF'

invalid
-----END PGP SIGNATURE-----
EOF
